newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION-AUCKLAND CLOSE IN ON HOME SEMIFINAL.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-AUCKLAND CLOSE IN ON HOME SEMIFINAL.

text.p: The Auckland Blues narrowed their sights on a home semifinal advantage in the Super 12 competition on Saturday, coming from behind to clinch a 45-28 victory over the Otago Highlanders at Carisbrook.
A fiercely determined Otago side scored two tries to one in the first spell and, going to the break 15-7 ahead, looked capable of pulling off an upset win.
But explosive Auckland winger Joeli Vidiri fired his powerhouse team into action in the second half, scoring a scorching solo try and setting up another.
The Fijian-born Vidiri outpaced the Otago defence on the right flank to score, giving Auckland a 19-18 lead which Carlos Spencer stretched to 21-18 with a successful conversion.
Vidiri's 50-metre mid-field burst a minute later allowed Robin Brooke to pick up the ball from the tackle a metre short of the line and dive over, nailing Otago's coffin.
Otago fought to the death, taking the game to the Super 12 leaders and scoring two more tries.
But Auckland's attacking and dynamic play eventually prevailed for a seven-tries-to-four victory, which earned both teams a bonus point.

Auckland Blues: Adrian Cashmore, Joeli Vidiri, Eroni Clarke, Jeremy Stanley, Lee Stensness, Carlos Spencer, Ofisa Tonu'u, Zinzan Brooke (captain), Mark Carter, Robin Brooke, Charles Riechelmann, Dylan Mika, Craig Dowd, Sean Fitzpatrick, Paul Thomson.

Otago Highlanders: Matt Carrington, Brendan Laney, To'o Vaega, Pailate Fili, John Leslie, Tony Brown, Stu Forster, Taine Randell (captain), Josh Kronfeld, John Blaikie, Steve Gordon, Kupu Vanisi, Kees Meeuws, Anton Oliver, Carl Hoeft.
